lines.zh: 我用四条腿贴着地面走
lines.en: I move low on four legs.
My claws dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地跟着味道
lines.en: I follow the scent, step by step.
I prowl along the base of the wall.
I creep forward, body low.

lines.zh: 我绕过一具倒下的躯体
lines.en: I step around a fallen body.
My tail swings behind me.
Nose to the ground, I follow hoofprints.

lines.zh: 我顺着气味绕过那片灌木
lines.en: I follow the scent around the brush.
I head toward anything living.
I break into a run, then slow.
I circle once around you.
I lie low and do not move.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有别的活物
lines.en: I listen for anything else alive.

lines.zh: 背上的裂口自己在开合
lines.en: The split on my back opens and closes.
I sharpen my claws on the ground.
These bodies are still fresh.
I lie still without moving.
I barely need to breathe.
I hide myself in the shade.
My head stays turned to the sound.
I lick my claws slowly.
The warmth hasn't left you yet.
I watch you without blinking.
I have pressed my head down.
You are taller, but slower.

lines.zh: 我在算你几步能跑多远
lines.en: I am working out how far you can run.
I circle your shadow.
My claws scrape the ground.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我就在你后面
lines.en: You cannot see me; I am behind you.
I am waiting for your back.
You should not walk alone at night.
I creep half a pace back.
My hide is cut open.
That clawing hurt.
I duck lower.
I shake my head.
My forelegs feel weak.
I back into the shade.
I have marked that claw.
Blood dripping, and I still pounce.
My blood drips to the ground.
That smells of flesh.
I edge one step toward it.
Lower your hand where I can reach.
I can tell; it is alive.
This is nowhere near enough.
I will take the first bite.
I come at your flank.
Waist height is low enough.
I am starting to drool.
I am not picky at all.
You crashed into me.
I slip away sideways.
You stepped on my claw.
Do not put your face so close.

lines.zh: 两下撞上，我喉咙里作响
lines.en: We clash, and my throat rattles.
I pull back and circle round.
Your strength is not weak.
I mark that on my claw.
I slip between your legs.
I crouch again.
A thing like me needs no mate.
I am busy hunting.
That does not concern me.
Do not ask about such things.
I lower myself and ignore you.

lines.zh: 这种事我自己都理不清
lines.en: I can't even sort that out myself.
There is only prey here.
I shake my head.
I go back to sniffing the ground.
I turn and walk off.
I take what falls.
I snatch it and shake it.
This is no longer fresh.
I swallow it in one go.
It sticks between my teeth.
Whose it is does not concern me.
I drag it into the shade.
Not worth it.
I sniff and drop it.
I walk right over it.
You are right in my path.

lines.zh: 你身上的血腥味我闻到了
lines.en: I have caught the blood on you.
My mark has been placed.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经扣进土里
lines.en: My claws are set in the earth.
I have crouched.
You cannot run fast at all.
Just you and me - fair enough.
I saw you first.
I have left the shadow.
You will be the next body.
My claws go into the dirt first.
This is what I waited for.
My tail stands straight up.
Do you hear the claws?

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经替你数好步
lines.en: My claws have already counted your steps.
I pad slowly around you.
I am behind you now.
You turn, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我的肚子擦着土往前滑
lines.en: My belly slides along the dirt.
I creep closer inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我一边潜行一边数你的动作
lines.en: I prowl and count your movements.
Your panting has gone ragged.
I wait for you to bend.
You are driven against the wall.
Only two steps lie between us.
My claws never stop.
I have come round to your flank.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道越来越浓
lines.en: Your scent is getting stronger.
I make not the slightest sound.
I sink down, ready to leap.
You will not dodge this.
I wait for the last moment.
I spring with my whole body.
I leap out at you.
My claws tear your leg.
The impact takes you down.
I bite into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 站起来几次我就咬几次
lines.en: Stand up again and I'll bite again.
That bite found its mark.
I spring off you.
Blood spatters my face.
I close my jaws and bite again.
My teeth are sharp.
Your arm came up half a beat late.
I pull back to circle.
This is my kill.
Still breathing? Then one more bite.
That should stop you walking.
My belly is still empty.
A second pair of eyes opens in the shadow.
A new line of claw prints on the ground.
First I sniffed the ground.
There is something living here.
My head rides very low.
I came from beside the bodies.
I shake the dirt off my back.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，找到了位置
lines.en: I crouch and find my spot.
This is good ground for an ambush.
I open my jaws slowly.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨了刨
lines.en: I scrape the ground with my claws.
The smell here is thick.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片地走了一圈
lines.en: I make one circuit of this ground.
I have everything set on my side.
Fire catches my hide.

lines.zh: 落地时我的爪子折了一下
lines.en: One of my claws folded on landing.
Water floods up through my snout.
The blast flips me against the wall.
An arrow pins my flank.
Magic numbs my legs.
Nothing living is left here.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我跳开了
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I bolt.
The ground beneath me is gone.
